scope: Final course batch source audit; derived and toy examples marked separately.

claims.claim: The official Troubleshooting guide distinguishes model download/load hangs, OOM, generation quality drift, GPU-CPU synchronization, NCCL network, CUDA Graph replay and torch.compile issues.
For models that cannot fit into the available memory, the official guide refers readers to its dedicated memory conservation strategies.
--load-format dummy can isolate model weight loading problems, but does not prove a real model will load correctly.
claims.locator: Hangs loading a model from disk

claims.claim: vLLM documentation describes a version change from neutral defaults to model generation_config.json and provides --generation-config vllm as a diagnostic alternative.
NCCL_DEBUG logging, VLLM_HOST_IP, NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME and GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME are documented for distributed initialization and network issues.
claims.locator: Enable more logging / Incorrect network setup
claims.notes: Use as controlled diagnostics, not an unconditional production fix.

claims.claim: --enforce-eager disables CUDA Graph optimization and can help isolate CUDA errors near graph replay.
VLLM_TRACE_FUNCTION can be extremely expensive and should only be used for narrowly scoped diagnosis.
The memory budget breakdown into weights, KV cache, workspace, runtime and fragmentation is an accounting model rather than an exact universal allocator formula.
